title: Sea of Hands
summary: With Oakland trailing late, Ken Stabler escaped pressure and found Clarence Davis in a crowd of Dolphins defenders for the go-ahead touchdown in a 28-26 AFC Divisional win.
playDetail: Stabler's eight-yard touchdown pass to Clarence Davis in the final seconds ended Miami's bid for a fourth straight Super Bowl appearance and became one of the signature plays in Raiders history.

title: Ghost to the Post
summary: Ken Stabler's 42-yard completion to Dave Casper set up the tying field goal before Oakland won the 1977 AFC Divisional playoff 37-31 in double overtime.
playDetail: With Oakland down three late in regulation, Stabler hit Casper deep down the middle for 42 yards. The play set up Errol Mann's tying field goal; Casper later caught the winning touchdown in the second overtime.

title: Red Right 88
summary: The Raiders preserved a 14-12 AFC Divisional victory when Cleveland's final pass on the play call known as Red Right 88 was intercepted in the end zone.
playDetail: Cleveland drove into scoring range in the closing seconds, but the passing play called Red Right 88 ended with a Raiders interception, sending Oakland on to the AFC Championship Game and eventually Super Bowl XV.
